description:
Modern Vietnamese Input Method Engine powered by F# NativeAOT and Text Services Framework.

BambooMintKey is an open-source, high-performance Vietnamese Input Method Engine (IME)
designed for Windows. It features an F# NativeAOT core implementing a formal 5-tuple
phonotactic model, native TSF integration, zero GC latency, and advanced English detection heuristics.

- Standardized English/Vietnamese toggle shortcut key to the key under Esc (~/`).
- Fixed TSF compartment focus echo issues across multiple active applications.
- Enhanced E/V taskbar and language bar icon state synchronization via UI thread marshaling, resolving msctf.dll crash hazards.
- Inno Setup standalone installer improvements with automatic ctfmon process handling.
